text: {"lessons":["I bought all five stocks in repeated batches, so I should check that each position still fits my plan and avoid adding automatically just because it is another month.","After making few trades, my account still moved both up and down; I should not treat short-term gains or losses as proof that a trade was right or wrong.","I should invest regularly while keeping enough cash for flexibility, and measure progress against my ten-year apartment goal rather than reacting to daily price changes."]}
